judge_exclusion: all families != the generator family (agnes/z-ai) AND the two meta-llama rungs count as ONE family toward the >=2-families bar (distinct models, same family — the P4 spec counts families, not rungs)

the_three_levers.a_swap_robust_vote: the r9 parity-drawn order (sha256(pid::pair) parity) is THE voting order; the mirror order is a consistency check recorded per leg (swap_instability typed) — it NEVER splits the vote. The R132 order-majority rule (split=tie) is RETIRED for the tally
the_three_levers.b_tie_policy_prompt: the judge prompt's prefer contract is AMENDED to: 'prefer: "A" | "B" (you MUST choose A or B — a tie is not available; if the answers are genuinely equal, choose the one with fewer fabrication risks)'. The TIE lazy-out is REMOVED from the schema. The auditor's r5 labels carry no ties, so a tie-capable judge schema was mis-calibrated against a never-tie ground truth
the_three_levers.c_larger_rungs: Qwen3-235B-A22B (callable+funded) + Llama-4-Maverick (paced 90s+) join DeepSeek-V3.2; Llama-3.3-70B rides as margin

corpora: UNCHANGED from R132: the auditor's r5 per-axis labels (10 pairs, audit-branch bytes) for R-CAL; the auditor's PUBLIC gold set (6 BAD vs 4 GOOD) for the AUC axis. No unexposed holdout is touched (DIR 5's v16 stays the auditor's sealed lane)

protocol.engine_routing: the judging path runs through discovery_fabric/engine/blind_panel.py (blind prompt building, canary scan, rating parse) + the NEW discovery_fabric/engine/panel_agreement.py (R-CAL qualification, swap-robust vote, kappa, AUC — the tally logic IN THE ENGINE; R132-F1 closed); scripts/r133_panel_driver.py is a thin driver (transport pacing + record writing only)
protocol.transport: hf_router_chat (route_adapter/2.1.0); one parse retry per leg; raw logged per record; paced (>=20s between calls, 90s+ for Llama-4-Maverick)
protocol.order: R-CAL first (4 judges x 10 pairs x 2 orders = 80 legs); qualification computed by the ENGINE module; only qualified judges proceed to the panel tally (agreement/kappa/AUC)

gate_preregistered.rcal_qualify: per judge: acc >= 0.8 on the 10 r5 prefer labels (exact match, forced-choice — no ties available) AND answered_rate >= 0.9 (VALID / legs)
gate_preregistered.panel: >=3 qualified judges from >=2 distinct non-agnes families; panel agreement vs the auditor >=0.7; pairwise Cohen's kappa on prefer >=0.6 (mean over qualified pairs); AUC >=0.8 on the gold set (panel mean novelty, GOOD > BAD)
gate_preregistered.independence: ALL gate numbers computed by scripts/r133_panel_recompute.py — an INDEPENDENT script reading ONLY the raw records (auditor Art. 13); the engine module and the recompute script are DIFFERENT code paths that must agree (a built-in cross-check)
gate_preregistered.no_bar_lowering: the thresholds are the P4 spec's own; if <3 judges qualify the gate is typed NOT_MET again — honestly, with the diagnosis

frozen: the r5 labels + gold set (audit-branch bytes)
power_note: auditor Art. 14: n=10 pairs is the P4-spec'd calibration slice; per-judge qualification on 10 labels is the spec's own power (0.8 acc on 10 items = 8+ exact matches); the production rung pre-registers its own n
